headerDisplay: Connect using the email and password from your LEDVANCE SMART+ WiFi app. No Tuya developer account is needed. Devices are discovered automatically; leave Device overrides empty unless you need to exclude, rename or configure a specific device.

countryCode.title: Country calling code (optional)
countryCode.description: Usually leave this unset. If required by your account, enter the calling code without +, for example 40 for Romania.

localControl.title: Enable local LAN control
localControl.description: Discover device addresses and keys automatically. Commands use the cloud if LAN control fails. Disable this if another integration holds the device's local connection.

offlineGrace.title: Time before reporting No Response (seconds)
offlineGrace.description: Retain the last confirmed state across brief connection failures.

exposeMaster.title: Show All Outlets / All Lights controls

exposeEffects.title: Show light effect switches (where supported)
exposeEffects.description: Creates switches for work modes such as scene or music. Custom scene editing is not provided.

exposePower.title: Expose power monitoring to compatible HomeKit apps
exposePower.description: Voltage, current, power and total energy are available in compatible apps such as Eve. Apple Home does not display these measurements.

id.title: Device ID
id.description: Copy the ID from the Homebridge discovery log.

version.title: LAN protocol (only needed with fixed IP)

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Logs discovery, transport selection and sanitized errors. Passwords, local keys, session IDs and signed request URLs are not logged.
